texto: In Thai, the standard universal greeting is «สวัสดี» (sawàtdii), used at any time of day. To show respect and suit the situation, expressions are often followed by polite final particles, whose use depends on the level of formality, the context and the speaker's preference: «ครับ» (khráp, high tone) and «ค่ะ» (khâ, falling tone in statements; «คะ» khá, high tone in questions) work as conventional markers of politeness in everyday interactions and in service situations. To say thank you, use «ขอบคุณ» (khɔ̀ɔp-khun), and to apologise or ask to pass, «ขอโทษ» (khɔ̌ɔ-thôot).
